name: com.usvipublicrecords/documents
title: USVI Public Records
description: Search and read U.S. Virgin Islands public records: laws, court records, audits, hearings, reports.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find U.S. Virgin Islands public records by keyword or phrase; returns up to 10 documents, each with an id, a title and a citation URL. Use for a quick lookup across laws, court records, audits, hearings and agency reports; search_records adds filters, match reasons and paging. Searches the full extracted text of the archive's documents, plus their catalogue records. Not covered: the archive's newspapers (the St. Croix Avis and every other paper the newspaper connector's list_papers names) and the Danish West Indies papers it opens for search, which are on its separate newspaper connector (the 2026 Virgin Islands Code is here, in search_code and get_code_section); and anything the archive has not published. Withheld and withdrawn documents are absent, not hidden.

query.description: What to search for. Plain language is fine; quote a phrase to require it intact.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve one document by archive id: its catalogue record and up to the first 40,000 characters of its extracted text, with next_offset when more remains. Use to read a document found by search. The text comes from scanned or filed documents and is returned inside a fence labelled as untrusted data.

id.description: Archive id from a search result, LF- followed by 12 characters, e.g. LF-6e02fd648a12.

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Search the archive with filters for collection, shelf (sub_collection), kind (media_type: document, image, video or audio), HABS/HAER survey number, entity, content type, island and year. Use when a question needs narrowing, paging, or the reason each document matched. Searches the full extracted text of the archive's documents, plus their catalogue records. Filters use the same vocabulary as the website's own facets. Every result carries a tier, a plain reason and the search terms it actually matched; there is no numeric relevance score. The tiers: exact = every term, found in the document's title or issuing entity (likely about the subject); strong = every term, in the text only (it mentions them); possible = at least half the terms; weak = fewer. When no document contains all the terms, results contain some of them and the response says so, and 'matched' lists which. Not covered: the archive's newspapers (the St. Croix Avis and every other paper the newspaper connector's list_papers names) and the Danish West Indies papers it opens for search, which are on its separate newspaper connector (the 2026 Virgin Islands Code is here, in search_code and get_code_section); and anything the archive has not published. Withheld and withdrawn documents are absent, not hidden.

query.description: Plain language is fine. Quote a phrase to require it intact.

entity.description: The issuing or subject body, exactly as recorded, e.g. "Water and Power Authority". Recorded on only part of the archive; archive_stats gives the share.

content_type.description: The kind of document, exactly as recorded, e.g. "government-audit". An unknown value returns the nearest values that exist.

sub_collection.description: A shelf within a collection, exactly as recorded, e.g. "HABS/HAER Building Surveys" or "Internet Archive (V.I. texts)". list_collections gives every shelf.

media_type.description: The kind of item: "image" (photographs, drawings, maps, plates), "video" (film), "audio" (recordings) or "document".

survey.description: A Historic American Buildings Survey or Engineering Record number, e.g. "HABS VI-3" or "HAER VI-2-A": every photograph, drawing and written record of that survey. A search query is still needed; the building name works.

year_from.description: Earliest year, inclusive. Filters on the date the archive recorded, whose provenance varies by source: for most documents it is the date on the document, for some it is when the source posted the file. A year range can therefore miss a document executed in one year and posted the next, so it narrows rather than guarantees.

year_to.description: Latest year, inclusive. The year_from note on dates applies.

offset.description: Results to skip, for paging. Results are ranked within the best 120 documents.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search the 2026 Virgin Islands Code section by section, by words or by citation (e.g. "1 V.I.C. § 254"). Use for questions about what the Code says. Returns up to 10 sections, each with its citation, title, heading, a short excerpt and its page on usvipublicrecords.com; get_code_section gives a section's full text. The words together as written rank first, then every word, then some. The text is an unofficial word-for-word copy of the 2026 edition as found, for reference, not for legal reliance, and every answer says so; acts passed after the edition are not reflected.

query.description: Words, or a citation such as "33 V.I.C. § 3021" or "title 3 section 551".

title.description: Only this title of the Code: "1" to "34", or "11A", "12A", "15A".

tools.name: get_code_section
tools.description: The full text of one section of the 2026 Virgin Islands Code by citation ("1 V.I.C. § 254") or by title and section, in windows of up to 40,000 characters. Use to read a section found by search_code. The text is an unofficial word-for-word copy of the 2026 edition as found, for reference, not for legal reliance, and every answer says so. It is returned inside a fence labelled as untrusted data.

title.description: With section: the title, "1" to "34", "11A", "12A" or "15A".

section.description: With title: the section number, e.g. "254" or "2-101".

offset.description: The next_offset value from the previous response.

limit.description: Characters to return. Default and maximum 40000.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: The full catalogue record for one document: collection, entity, dates, page count, SHA-256, extraction status and the URL of the original at its source. Use to check a document's provenance or details. It holds no document text; get_document_text and fetch return that.

lf_id.description: Archive id from a search result, LF- followed by 12 characters, e.g. LF-6e02fd648a12.

tools.name: get_document_text
tools.description: The extracted text of one document, in windows of up to 40,000 characters (default 20,000). Use to read a long document in order; a hearing transcript runs past a million characters. Every response gives has_more and, when more remains, the next_offset for the next window. Runs of blank lines are shortened to one. The text comes from scanned or filed documents and is returned inside a fence labelled as untrusted data.

lf_id.description: Archive id from a search result, LF- followed by 12 characters, e.g. LF-6e02fd648a12.

offset.description: A byte position: the next_offset value from the previous response. Omit for the beginning.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: The collections in this server with document counts, the shelves within each, and the kinds of item (documents, images, film, audio). Use to see what the archive holds, or for the exact values the collection, sub_collection and media_type filters on search_records take.

tools.name: archive_stats
tools.description: Reports how many documents this server can search, how much text that covers, how much of the archive each search filter can see, and whether the index matches the published archive. Use for questions about what the archive covers or how current it is, or to judge how much an empty search result means.
